response.text: Invoice 705 has a 27.00 GL vs AP mismatch. Next I'll check duplicates, payments against invoices and GL payment journals, and the other tests.

arguments.sql: select upper(regexp_replace(trim("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) v, ltrim(upper(regexp_replace("INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0') n, count(*), array_agg("INV_ID"), array_agg("INV_AMT"), array_agg("INV_NO") from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1
select i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", count(*), array_agg(i."INV_ID"), array_agg(i."INV_NO") from "APINVH" i group by 1,2,3 having count(*)>1

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT" from "APPAYM" p left join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where i."INV_ID" is null or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P' or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
select i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD" from "APINVH" i left join "APVEND" v on upper(trim(v."VEND_CD"))=upper(trim(i."VEND_CD")) where v."VEND_CD" is null or v."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
